RULE-ST01-02: If TMP exceeds 26°C, reduce speed by 10% and notify QC.
RULE-ST01-03: PRS drop below 3.3 bar — inspect inlet valve within 5 min.
RULE-ST02-01: TMP MUST remain between 175°C and 195°C.

RULE-ST03-01: TEN MUST be between 1.8 and 2.6 N.
RULE-ST03-02: CNT below 110 pcs/min — check for label jam. Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt.
RULE-ST03-03: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples — sensor failure.
RULE-ST04-01: VIB > 0.20 mm/s (WARNING) — schedule maintenance within 24 h.
RULE-ST04-02: VIB > 0.35 mm/s (CRITICAL) — emergency stop; inspect bearings.
RULE-ST04-03: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command — verify RULE-ST02-04.
RULE-SRV01-02: TMP > 28°C (CRITICAL) — automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes.

RULE-WRH01-01: TMP MUST remain between 0.5°C and 8°C. CRITICAL above 12°C — notify QC and
quarantine batch.
RULE-WRH01-02: HUM above 85%RH — inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier.

RULE-CHM01-01: TMP MUST remain between 10°C and 20°C. CRITICAL above 25°C — activate emergency
ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.

RULE-CHM01-02: HUM MUST NOT exceed 50%RH. Elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic
reagents. Activate desiccant system if HUM >45%RH.

RULE-CHM01-03: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to
enter Chemical Storage. UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes.
RULE-RND01-01: TMP MUST remain between 18°C and 26°C for experimental validity.

RULE-RND01-02: HUM drift above 65%RH — activate dehumidifier. Above 75%RH (CRITICAL) — suspend
sensitive experiments and inspect HVAC system.
RULE-CAF01-01: TMP above 26°C — check ventilation system. Occupant comfort is the primary criterion.
RULE-CAF01-02: HUM above 70%RH — inspect drainage and activate ventilation.

Note 2 — Continuous Overload Rating: The sensor is rated for continuous operation up to 14 A. Operation between
14 A and 20 A is permissible for short durations (< 60 seconds). Sustained operation above 14 A will cause
progressive accuracy drift. ElectroMeasure recommends that process alarm thresholds triggering corrective action be
set no higher than the continuous overload rating.

Application Note — Alarm Threshold Setting: With a total accuracy of ±0.10 bar, alarm thresholds should be set at
least 5× the accuracy (0.50 bar) from the nominal operating point to avoid nuisance alarms. Thresholds closer than
3× accuracy (0.30 bar) are not recommended for process control.

Note 1 — Maximum Operating Temperature: The rated maximum for continuous operation is 200°C. Exposure
above this value accelerates thermocouple ageing and may cause drift of up to ±5°C within 500 hours. For
applications requiring sustained operation above 200°C, ThermoSense recommends the Series 2400 (Pt100 RTD,
rated to 250°C continuous).
